local.phone_inconsistent.title: 4 different phone numbers appear across the site
local.phone_inconsistent.detail: Multiple numbers make it hard for Google to match the site to one business listing. Found: (616) 555-0134, (616) 555-0188, (616) 555-0199, (616) 555-0150. No second set of premises and no locator page could be found on this site, so these read as variants of one line rather than one number per branch.
local.phone_inconsistent.fix: Use one primary number consistently site-wide, matching your Google Business Profile exactly. Put secondary numbers only on the pages they belong to.

local.address_inconsistent.title: 5 address variations appear across the site
local.address_inconsistent.detail:
Different formattings of an address ('St' vs 'Street', 'Ste 210' vs 'Suite 210') weaken the match between your site and your business listing.

The spellings found, most common first:

* 412 mill street, suite 2 grand rapids 49503
* 412 mill street
* 412 mill st
* 412 mill st ste
* 412 mill street unit
local.address_inconsistent.fix: Standardise on one exact format everywhere, matching your Google Business Profile character for character.
